thread:
Ravi: hey team, first day build trouble. on a fresh Ubuntu 22.04 dev box with an RTX 6000 Ada. running `make all` in runtime, and ptxas fails: `ptxas fatal : Value 'sm_90' is not supported by this version of ptxas`.

Samir: welcome! quick check: what's `nvcc --version` and which CUDA toolkit did you install? also paste the exact CMake or Make flags if you can.

Ravi: nvcc -> Cuda compilation tools, release 11.8, V11.8.89. build log shows `-gencode=arch=compute_90,code=sm_90` injected by our Makefile. not sure why sm_90 is there since toolkit is 11.8.

Mika: Ada GPUs (compute 9.0) are supported starting in CUDA 12.x, so nvcc 11.8 won't accept sm_90. Two options: install CUDA 12+ or remove/adjust the sm_90 targets so nvcc emits PTX only or targets a lower arch.

Ravi: I tried removing sm_90 from the gencode flag in Makefile and re-running, but now ld errors: `undefined reference to __cudaRegisterFatBinary` during link. feels like object files from different compilers mixed.

Samir: yup mixed-toolkit artifacts are the common culprit. Do a full clean: `git clean -xfd && rm -rf build/` then rebuild. Also check `ccache` and docker caches. If you compiled any object earlier with CUDA12 and now linking with 11.8 (or vice versa) you'll see that symbol mismatch.

Mika: we recommend using our pinned dev container image to avoid host toolkit problems: `docker run --rm -it -v $PWD:/src -w /src redwood/runtime-dev:cuda12-ubuntu22.04 bash` then `cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=RelWithDebInfo && cmake --build build -j8`.

Ravi: good call. is there a quick way to detect in CMake which arch list to use based on nvcc version? I'd rather make a small repo change so newcomers don't hit this.

Samir: yes, add logic to cmake/arch.cmake to query `nvcc --version` or use `CMAKE_CUDA_TOOLKIT_VERSION` and pick architecture list accordingly. We do something similar in our internal CI scripts. If toolkit >= 12 set `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES` to include 90; otherwise exclude.

Ravi: ok I'll try the container first. if that works I'll open a tiny PR to make the arch list conditional and add a blurb to docs/dev/onboarding.md about requiring CUDA12+ for Ada.

build-bot: CI job 4927 will run on branch ravi/cuda12-conditional-arch after PR is created.

Ravi: container build passed, full compile succeeded after cleaning caches. unit tests launching. I'll open the PR and tag Samir and Mika for review.

Mika: great. when you open it, add a short troubleshooting note about `__cudaRegisterFatBinary` and mixed toolkit artifacts (we've burned new hires on that). also mention clearing `ccache` and removing stale /usr/local/cuda symlinks.

Samir: welcome aboard, and ping us if you hit perf regressions after changing archs 1 we have a perf debug checklist.

Ravi: thanks all, really appreciate the fast help!
